tutorial.title: Getting Started
tutorial.claudeTitle: How to use Skills in Claude Code or Claude AI
tutorial.claudeIntro: Claude includes products like Claude Code and Claude AI by Anthropic. With Skills Hub, you can quickly import skills into these apps.
tutorial.claudeStep1: Open the command line in the Claude app
tutorial.claudeStep2: Find the install command of the skill (e.g. /plugin marketplace add lackeyjb-playwright-skill) and run it
tutorial.codebuddyTitle: How to use Skills in CodeBuddy
tutorial.codebuddyIntro: CodeBuddy is an AI-native IDE by Tencent. With Skills Hub, you can use these skills in your AI coding workflow.
tutorial.codebuddyStep1: Find the skill and get the git URL, then clone it to a local folder
tutorial.codebuddyStep3: In Settings → Skills, import the folder to personal/project skills
